title: Replace Scholar Gold logo and icon assets with new gold circular v3 design

requirements.summary: Add new cache-safe Scholar Gold PNG logo/app-icon assets (v3) matching the provided gold circular reference design in standard sizes.
acceptanceCriteria: New PNG image assets exist under frontend/public/assets/generated with cache-safe filenames and at minimum sizes 32x32, 192x192, and 512x512.
The exported images clearly match the reference look: navy radial background, gold circular motif/border with glow, central book icon, and readable “Scholar Gold” + “MADE BY PD” text.
The 32x32 favicon remains legible and recognizable at small size (no muddy/blurred text artifacts).

file_operations.description: Add the new ornate circular gold-and-navy logo/app-icon PNG (512x512) based on Screenshot_2026_0210_153957.jpg and the provided HTML/CSS design cues.
Add the simplified but matching gold-and-navy icon PNG (192x192) derived from the same v3 design.
Add the highly legible small favicon PNG (32x32) derived from the same v3 design, optimized for clarity at small size.

requirements.summary: Update favicon/app-icon links and in-app brand logo references to use the new v3 cache-safe icon filenames (replace all v2 references).
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html no longer references scholar-gold-*-v2.* files and instead references the new v3 (or otherwise cache-safe) filenames for 32x32, 192x192, and 512x512 icons.

frontend/src/components/Header.tsx and frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx no longer reference /assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon-v2.dim_512x512.png and instead reference the new logo/app-icon filename.
After a normal reload (no manual cache clearing), the browser tab favicon and the in-app brand logo both display the new gold circular design.

file_operations.description: Replace v2 icon link hrefs with the new v3 generated asset paths: frontend/public/assets/generated/scholar-gold-favicon-v3.dim_32x32.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon-v3.dim_192x192.png, and frontend/public/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon-v3.dim_512x512.png.
Update the brand logo src to reference the new v3 logo/app-icon asset (frontend/public/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon-v3.dim_512x512.png) and remove any v2 filename usage.
Update the login header brand logo src to reference the new v3 logo/app-icon asset (frontend/public/assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon-v3.dim_512x512.png) and remove any v2 filename usage.
